name: PermitGuard
tagline: Human-confirmed lockout/tagout permit decision support in Jira. Site procedures remain authoritative.
legacy_summary: Review permit phases, attributable personal locks and separate work-start and release blockers in Jira. Synthetic evaluation only: not safety certification, a physical interlock or permission to energize.
more_details: PermitGuard brings lockout/tagout permit decision support to a Jira issue panel. Review Plan, Lock, Verify, Active, Release and Closed phases, equipment isolation points, personal locks and separate work-start and release decisions. Named humans retain confirmation authority; native Rovo can read readiness or propose PENDING, never confirm activation. New projects default to Warn-only. Administrators can explicitly load six synthetic equipment items into an eligible empty demo register. Connection and appropriate Jira permissions are required. Evaluation only: full production lifecycle, distinct-two-human and cross-browser Realtime acceptance remain pending. Site procedures remain authoritative; this is not safety certification, a physical interlock or permission to energize. Personal-data reporting, erase/refresh and retention handling remain incomplete; use synthetic content only.
